author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Skyhigh Security Secure Web Gateway lines in the default access log format. The appliance's rsyslog forwards them to the data collector. Every request goes to HTTP.
notes:
Setup:
- Add a rule next to Write access.log that runs the event Syslog (6, User-Defined.logLine), and have the appliance's rsyslog forward daemon.info to the data collector, as Skyhigh's syslog guide shows.
- The line keeps the default access log format; the log prefix (mwg by default) isn't checked.
- If you can choose the format: in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 a CEF line with the McAfee Web Gateway header went to the built-in McAfee_WebGateway parser and was normalized to HTTP (Taegis XDR documents that integration).
- This entry is for gateways that send the default access log, which no built-in parser claimed.

Field mapping:
- Every request goes to HTTP: time, client address and user, status, method and URL, bytes each way and the user agent, with blocked set when block_res isn't 0, and the URL categories, reputation, media type, virus name, application and block reason ID in event_metadata (Skyhigh's list of block reason IDs explains the numbers).
- Older defaults without bytes_from_client and application_name also match; a logging rule edited to write other fields won't.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the documented default format.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (126 of 126 fields matched the emulator, in each of 2 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 8 Run Tests.
